Nick — thanks for the clear asks. Below is a recommended operational plan we’ve used successfully with similar accounts; happy to adapt.

Proposed plan (recommended):
- Commercial: Annual committed amount split into two equal prepay invoices (H1 / H2). This reduces bank fees and simplifies reconciliation.
- Operational drawdowns: monthly drawdown windows within each half-year (example: funds released on the 1st of each month against usage).
- Invoice fields we require from your PO: PO number(s), remit entity name, tax/withholding instructions, and any AP contact name/email.

Why this hybrid approach? Two prepay invoices keep your treasury planning simple while monthly drawdowns keep unit economics and usage alignment tight — we track drawdowns in a shared tracker and automatically reconcile.

Next steps we need from Starlight:
- AP contact and remit details (bank account, wire vs ACH, remittance email).
- VAT registration docs for entities that will receive invoices (attachment or link).
- Whether you want Redwood to invoice the UK entity (for VAT reclaim) or the US parent.

I’ve attached: redwood-SOW-annual-prepay-2025.pdf (signature-ready) and invoice-grid-tranche-proposal.xlsx (example schedule and amounts). I’ll loop Grace for the invoice/ops specifics and Laura for the tax/legal routing.

Regards,
